recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18606 unless a future work group decision reopens the broader CanonicalResource.date model.
issue_request: FHIR-18606 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 Vocab CodeSystem.date, asking to replace "The date (and optionally time) when the code system was published." with "The date (and optionally time) when the code system resource was created or revised."
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249, whose terminology ballot spreadsheet patch added the resolved created-or-revised CodeSystem.date wording. Later source history no longer retained that exact wording on CodeSystem.date, and the related accidental placement of that sentence on CodeSystem.status was fixed by FHIR-24865.
additional_context: FHIR-37858 later clarified CanonicalResource.date by separating last-significant-change dates from publication dates. Commit 378fe392dd102168828a322355a66656eff4d1bb changed CodeSystem.date from stale publish-date wording to "last significantly changed" and added the draft/publication/last-modified distinction; commit 49b86f8a6978650d8f8a6d36d27dee0433e455bc retained that model while adding local-change guidance. FHIR-37858 minutes and Zulip discussion confirm the broader date/publicationDate decision path.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active CodeSystem source says CodeSystem.date is when the code system was last significantly changed, requires changes when business version, status, or substantive content changes, and comments that the date may exist before publication and is not the resource last-modified date. Current source has no remaining matches for the old publish-date sentence or the older created-or-revised sentence.
